title: What is a Skill?

body.text: that teaches an AI to do a specialized task consistently. Instead of retyping long instructions every time, you store the method as a Skill and just call it — like a 'recipe' the AI picks up and uses.

example: Instead of explaining your brand's writing style every time → create a 'Write in our brand style' Skill to call on

title: Why it's useful

body.text: , give the whole team the same standard, and save time. They're great for frequently repeated work — checking documents against a checklist, formatting reports, or reviewing code to team rules.

example: A 'Review contract' Skill that knows the legal checklist your team uses → the same standard review on every contract

options.text: A packaged set of instructions + knowledge to teach AI a repeatable specialized task

question: What's the main benefit of a Skill?

options.text: Consistent results and time savings on repeated work
It makes the AI respond slower

question: What work is a good fit for a Skill?

options.text: Frequently repeated, standardized work like checking documents against a checklist
Work with no fixed pattern at all
